mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outboundDetail ( outboundId, goodsCode, outboundQuantity, batchNo, warehouseCode, createTime, updateTime, isDeleted ) VALUES ( #{outboundId}, #{goodsCode}, #{outboundQuantity}, #{batchNo}, #{warehouseCode}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDeleted} )
mapper.update: UPDATE outboundDetail SET outboundId = #{outboundId}, goodsCode = #{goodsCode}, outboundQuantity = #{outboundQuantity}, batchNo = #{batchNo}, warehouseCode = #{warehouseCode}, updateTime = #{updateTime}, isDeleted = #{isDeleted} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM outboundDetail WHERE id = #{id} AND isDeleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE outboundDetail SET isDeleted = #{isDeleted}, updateTime = NOW() WHERE outboundId = #{outboundId}

SELECT o.goodsCode AS goodsCode, g.goodsName AS goodsName, SUM(o.outboundQuantity) AS totalOutboundQuantity FROM outboundDetail o LEFT JOIN goods g ON o.goodsCode = g.goodsCode WHERE o.isDeleted = 0 AND o.createTime >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY o.goodsCode, g.goodsName ORDER BY totalOutboundQuantity DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.createTime, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(o.outboundQuantity) AS quantity FROM outboundDetail o WHERE o.isDeleted = 0 AND o.createTime >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.createTime, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT gc.id AS categoryId, gc.categoryName AS categoryName, 0 AS totalInbound, SUM(o.outboundQuantity) AS totalOutbound FROM outboundDetail o LEFT JOIN goods g ON o.goodsCode = g.goodsCode LEFT JOIN goodsCategory gc ON g.categoryId = gc.id WHERE o.isDeleted = 0 AND o.createTime >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY gc.id, gc.categoryName ORDER BY totalOutbound DESC
